_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_cant_sacrifice_static.py. t_suit is Assault Suit's prohibition alone -- a cant_sacrifice static with affects {attached: true} -- and t_open_suit is the same protecting every creature you control, so the tests can show the filter is really read rather than matching whatever is nearest. t_altar is a sacrifice OUTLET: its activated ability costs a creature, which is the cost road into temp_effects.sacrifice_forbidden. The effect road needs no card of its own: op_sacrifice filters its pool with the same sacrifice_forbidden predicate the cost road reads, which is the point of there being one seam, and testing.cards.json already ships a t_edict. t_cs_bear and t_cs_dork are the fodder.
